lead_post.text:
Chinese appliance giants are cashing in on Europe’s record heat waves, with demand for air conditioners surging just as the EU debates new tariffs on Chinese imports. According to Chinese customs data, exports of air conditioners to EU countries hit $3.76 billion in the first half of 2026, up 43.2% year on year, setting a new record. Shipments to France, the Netherlands and Belgium more than doubled in the first five months, while Spain, Germany and Portugal also saw strong double-digit growth. On retail platforms the spike was even starker: at JD dot com’s European site Joybuy, AC sales jumped nearly 40 times during the June 19-25 heatwave compared with early June. Consumers are queuing and driving across borders to find stock. One Austrian buyer drove 200km to Linz to buy the last Midea PortaSplit in the country.

The boom is led by portable and easy-install models from Gree, Haier, Hisense, Midea and TCL, which fit Europe’s housing constraints better than traditional split systems. In many historic European cities, drilling into facades is banned and professional installation can cost 1,500 to 2,000 euros with waits of two months. Midea’s PortaSplit, priced around 1,000 euros and weighing under 10kg, requires no professional fitting and sold 200,000 units in Europe this year, double 2025 levels. Midea expects European consumer AC sales to grow more than 20% in Q2, Haier could see double-digit growth in the segment, and Gree reported sales in France, Italy and Spain up over 40% in the first half. Euromonitor projects Haier, Gree and Midea will together hold about 32% of the European retail AC market by volume. Chinese officials and state media are framing the surge as proof that Europe needs Chinese products, with Xinhua calling it the air conditioner paradox: Europe is too hot for tariffs on China. That argument is landing amid broader EU-China talks over a nearly 360 billion euro trade imbalance, even as commodity costs and weak domestic demand at home pressure margins for the manufacturers.

- World Business News.

lead_post.translation_zh:
中国家电巨头正从欧洲创纪录的热浪中获利，空调需求激增，而此时欧盟正就对中国进口商品征收新关税展开讨论。根据中国海关数据，2026年上半年，对欧盟国家的空调出口额达到 37.6 亿美元，同比增长 43.2%，创下新纪录。前五个月，对法国、荷兰和比利时的发货量增长了一倍多，而西班牙、德国和葡萄牙也出现了强劲的两位数增长。在零售平台上，这一激增更为明显：在 JD.com 的欧洲网站 Joybuy 上，6月19日至25日热浪期间的空调销量较6月初跃升近 40 倍。消费者正在排队并跨境驾车寻找库存。一名奥地利买家驾车 200km 前往林茨，买下了该国最后一台 Midea PortaSplit。

这轮热潮由 Gree、Haier、Hisense、Midea 和 TCL 的便携式及易安装机型引领，这些机型比传统分体式系统更适合欧洲的住房限制。在许多欧洲历史名城，禁止在外立面钻孔，而专业安装费用可达 1,500 至 2,000 欧元，等待时间长达两个月。Midea 的 PortaSplit 售价约 1,000 欧元，重量低于 10kg，无需专业安装，今年在欧洲售出 200,000 台，是 2025 年水平的两倍。Midea 预计第二季度欧洲消费者空调销量将增长超过 20%，Haier 在该细分市场可能实现两位数增长，Gree 报告称上半年在法国、意大利和西班牙的销售额增长超过 40%。Euromonitor 预计，按销量计算，Haier、Gree 和 Midea 合计将占欧洲零售空调市场约 32%。中国官员和官方媒体正将这波激增描述为欧洲需要中国产品的证据，新华社称其为空调悖论：欧洲热到无法对中国征收关税。在欧中围绕近 3600 亿欧元贸易失衡展开更广泛谈判之际，这一论点正在产生影响，尽管大宗商品成本和国内需求疲软也在挤压制造商的利润率。

- World Business News.

featured_items.original_text:
Chinese appliance giants are cashing in on Europe’s record heat waves, with demand for air conditioners surging just as the EU debates new tariffs on Chinese imports. According to Chinese customs data, exports of air conditioners to EU countries hit $3.76 billion in the first half of 2026, up 43.2% year on year, setting a new record. Shipments to France, the Netherlands and Belgium more than doubled in the first five months, while Spain, Germany and Portugal also saw strong double-digit growth. On retail platforms the spike was even starker: at JD dot com’s European site Joybuy, AC sales jumped nearly 40 times during the June 19-25 heatwave compared with early June. Consumers are queuing and driving across borders to find stock. One Austrian buyer drove 200km to Linz to buy the last Midea PortaSplit in the country.

The boom is led by portable and easy-install models from Gree, Haier, Hisense, Midea and TCL, which fit Europe’s housing constraints better than traditional split systems. In many historic European cities, drilling into facades is banned and professional installation can cost 1,500 to 2,000 euros with waits of two months. Midea’s PortaSplit, priced around 1,000 euros and weighing under 10kg, requires no professional fitting and sold 200,000 units in Europe this year, double 2025 levels. Midea expects European consumer AC sales to grow more than 20% in Q2, Haier could see double-digit growth in the segment, and Gree reported sales in France, Italy and Spain up over 40% in the first half. Euromonitor projects Haier, Gree and Midea will together hold about 32% of the European retail AC market by volume. Chinese officials and state media are framing the surge as proof that Europe needs Chinese products, with Xinhua calling it the air conditioner paradox: Europe is too hot for tariffs on China. That argument is landing amid broader EU-China talks over a nearly 360 billion euro trade imbalance, even as commodity costs and weak domestic demand at home pressure margins for the manufacturers.

- World Business News.
featured_items.translation_zh:
中国家电巨头正从欧洲创纪录的热浪中获利，空调需求激增，而此时欧盟正就对中国进口商品征收新关税展开讨论。根据中国海关数据，2026年上半年，对欧盟国家的空调出口额达到 37.6 亿美元，同比增长 43.2%，创下新纪录。前五个月，对法国、荷兰和比利时的发货量增长了一倍多，而西班牙、德国和葡萄牙也出现了强劲的两位数增长。在零售平台上，这一激增更为明显：在 JD.com 的欧洲网站 Joybuy 上，6月19日至25日热浪期间的空调销量较6月初跃升近 40 倍。消费者正在排队并跨境驾车寻找库存。一名奥地利买家驾车 200km 前往林茨，买下了该国最后一台 Midea PortaSplit。

这轮热潮由 Gree、Haier、Hisense、Midea 和 TCL 的便携式及易安装机型引领，这些机型比传统分体式系统更适合欧洲的住房限制。在许多欧洲历史名城，禁止在外立面钻孔，而专业安装费用可达 1,500 至 2,000 欧元，等待时间长达两个月。Midea 的 PortaSplit 售价约 1,000 欧元，重量低于 10kg，无需专业安装，今年在欧洲售出 200,000 台，是 2025 年水平的两倍。Midea 预计第二季度欧洲消费者空调销量将增长超过 20%，Haier 在该细分市场可能实现两位数增长，Gree 报告称上半年在法国、意大利和西班牙的销售额增长超过 40%。Euromonitor 预计，按销量计算，Haier、Gree 和 Midea 合计将占欧洲零售空调市场约 32%。中国官员和官方媒体正将这波激增描述为欧洲需要中国产品的证据，新华社称其为空调悖论：欧洲热到无法对中国征收关税。在欧中围绕近 3600 亿欧元贸易失衡展开更广泛谈判之际，这一论点正在产生影响，尽管大宗商品成本和国内需求疲软也在挤压制造商的利润率。

- World Business News.
